summary: Mews-style Hub Pages feature tested successfully. All 9 sidebar sections display correctly. Clicking section headers opens hub landing pages with 3-column card grids and search functionality. Hub card clicks navigate to actual panels. containsActive logic auto-expands sections when user is inside a panel. Overview section excluded from hub navigation by design (always shows dashboard). All 10 regression panels working.

Minor: Some 404 errors in console for resource loading - likely missing assets, not critical.

Clicking section header (except Overview) opens hub page with cards grid. Hub pages have data-testid='section-hub-{section-name}' format. Hub cards have data-testid='hub-card-{item-testId}' format. Hub search has data-testid='hub-search'. Overview section is excluded from hub navigation by design - it always shows dashboard items directly.
